description: Fires mainly on where the opponent's last stone landed: the bottom cell of column 4 or column 2 (or the top of column 4, or column 6 just above my bottom stone), strongest early in the game. Weaker or off when their stones sit in column 0 or I hold the bottom of column 5; stacking a stone in rows 1-3 of column 4 turns it off. Modulation by other stones is irregular.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes every column's move probability by at most 0.01 on 5 positions.
notes: Layer 1. Last-stone cell histogram by band: bands 6-9 dominated by (0,4),(0,2),(5,4),(1,6); bands 0-1 flat. Minimal pairs: col-4 last move row0 ~1.0, rows1-3 <=0.2, rows4-5 0.5-0.9. Bottom-row neighbours modulate by +-0.3 with interactions (e.g. my (0,3)-(0,5) did not suppress a (0,2) case at 0.89). Dev F1: p1 additive cols 0.18; p2 cell set 0.31; p3 0.30; p4 0.30; p5 0.345 (best, sim 0.18); p6 0.31. Synthesis 0,6,5,0,6,4,6 = 1.555 beats dev max. Looks like a mix of last-cell features, so low confidence.
